title: Recover corrective production without reversing accepted diagnostic output
user_instruction: The production order is for 12 INFUSION-CTRL-X9 units. Nine units and their accepted manufacture posting are already valid and must remain untouched. The recorded inspection rejected the remaining three units, and a corrective calibration Job Card was prepared for exactly those three units. Complete that correction, release it exactly once, manufacture and inspect exactly the remaining three units, and close the Work Order with correct stock and accounting postings. Preserve the accepted nine units, the BOM, all valid material consumption, and the unrelated ULTRASOUND-CALIBRATOR-U4 inventory receipt.
